_doc: Curated overlay of confirmed Turkish-original titles → STREAMING platform IDs. Used when RapidAPI/TMDB are missing TR-specific platform data. Lookup is byTmdbId first, then byNormalizedTitle as fallback. v3: removed broadcast/free-to-air channels (Show TV, ATV, TRT, Star TV) — those are airing networks, not streaming services. v2: removed BluTV (consolidated under HBO Max which TMDB/RapidAPI already serve). Streaming-only IDs: gain, exxen, tabii, tod, puhutv, netflix.
